versions.content: function AddOcspResponse [SWS_CRYPT_50124] Upstream: RS_CRYPTO_02306 virtual ara::core::Result < CertificateValidationStatus > AddOcsp Response (OcspResponse::Sptrc ocspResponse, ara::core::Optional < Certificate ::Sptrc > trustedOcspIssuerCertificate) noexcept=0; Validate and add an OCSP response to be used during certificate validation to the set of previously added OCSP responses. Multiple OCSP responses may be added to one context. In order to validate the OCSP response, the issuer of the OCSP response must have been a) set as a trusted or untrusted certificate in this context previously, or b) the CRL must have been signed by another certificate that has the id-kp-OCSPSigning extended key usage set issued by the same CA, or c) the CRL must be signed by a trusted CA passed to this function using the optional trustedOcspIssuerCertificate parameter. Header-Datei #include "ara/crypto/x509/certificate_validation_ctx.h" class mono Scope class ara::crypto::x509::CertificateValidationCtx class mono Exception-Sicherheit exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit thread-safe class mono Parameter (in) th Parameter th Beschreibung td ocspResponse td The OCSP response to be used during certificate validation. td trustedOcspIssuerCertificate td If provided, the certificate to be considered trusted during validation of the OCSP response. If not provided, the certificates added via AddTrustedCertificate are considered trusted. Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td ara::core::Result < CertificateValidationStatus > td a result containing kValid if the response was added, or the result of the OCSP response validation, or an implementation specific error otherwise.
